text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The new year has begun. Copano Rickey 
moves up to the Classic tier this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
January 2nd. Relaxing on my own since it's 
still New Year's break...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Happy New Year! Come on, 
training, training☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Even just a little bit, let's get it 
done~. The sooner we get to work, the 
smoother everything will go♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after a light jog around the 
track, we decided to take it easy 
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, getting a little run in really does 
tone you right up, doesn't it♪ Well then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I prayed that the protection of the Four 
Symbols would remain with us this year as 
well...
choice_data_list: Ricky, what were the Four Gods again?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Four Symbols? Ah, the Four Symbols are 
also known as the 'Four Divine Beasts,' 
which means—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"In feng shui, they're the 'Four Divine 
Beasts' that protect the cardinal 
directions, right?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Azure Dragon of the East, Vermilion Bird 
of the South, White Tiger of the West, 
Black Tortoise of the North.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And at the center of it all, it is 
believed there is the "Yellow Dragon" that 
governs all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I once had a dream 
where I was about to drown and got saved 
by the Azure Dragon, one of the Four 
Auspicious Beasts!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why I interpret my guardian beast 
as the "Azure Dragon," you know?
choice_data_list:
I see, so it has a strong connection to 
the "Azure Dragon".

I see, so you have a strong connection 
with "Seiryu."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that divine blessing, Copano Rickey 
will surely be able to run with a positive 
spirit this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but since it's the New Year, wouldn't 
you want to share in the good fortune of 
the other Four Sacred Beasts too?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta indulge ourselves once in a while♪ 
So, how about we venture a little 
further?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—Suzaku, Byakko, Genbu. To a place where 
we might receive the blessings of the 
other Four Divine Beasts!”
choice_data_list: Okay, shall we give it a try then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agreeing with the idea, I let my thoughts 
wander. Now then, which of the Four 
Auspicious Beasts should we do something 
with, and what?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Into the sky with the Vermilion Bird, 
huh? Speaking of the sky, it's gotta be 
there☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Ricky-chan! Ricky☆ Lucky☆ Do you 
copy?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Eye copy! What a coincidence, Maya-chan."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I happened to bump into at 
the airport was Mayano Top Gun—a girl who 
loves airplanes and has flashes of sheer 
genius.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan, what are you doing at the 
airport?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! I came to look at all 
kinds of airplanes! Maya knows a whole 
bunch about them!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to look around together too, 
Ricky-chan?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. So the fallen feathers of 
the Vermilion Bird hold knowledge within 
them, do they?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it okay? Can we study together 
with Maya today?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
See that? That's the latest passenger 
plane! The seats are arranged in a zigzag 
so it can fit a whole lot of people.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And that cargo plane over there, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun happily explained it to 
her. Copano Rickey received a blessing of 
wisdom from the Vermilion Bird.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The White Tiger, huh? White Tiger means 
white tiger☆ I wonder if the place with 
white tigers is over there."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the zoo really is the best! Ah, 
there they are! So cute~♪

text_block_list.name: White Tiger
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrr~)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When she's being quiet, she's just like a 
cat. Let's play together today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rawr-rawr tiger, rawr-rawr-ring?

text_block_list.name: White Tiger
text_block_list.text: (Rawr!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Tiger-py!!" 
craftsmanship

text_block_list.name: White Tiger
text_block_list.text: (Rawr, rawr!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey played to her heart's 
content with the White Tiger. It seemed to 
have been a great way to unwind.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Take on Genbu's hardness? Hmm, nothing 
comes to mind right away, but is there 
anywhere we could challenge?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arrived at the classical 
martial arts dojo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-san, are you the one who wishes to 
challenge the defenses of the Kongo 
Yaegaki style?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Come at me from any angle you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what is this?!
choice_data_list:
Let's start with an introduction to 
martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The martial artist Umamusume, Yaeno 
Muteki. Her guard must surely be as 
impenetrable as the shell of the Black 
Tortoise.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right, here goes☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickeyâ Heart-Piercing Puuunch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smack)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Against something like this, I can easily 
take it without needing to dodge. 
However... you are quite adept at reading 
your opponent's spirit."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You seem to learn quickly. Since we're 
here, would you like to learn a bit of the 
Kongo Yaegaki style?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, since we're here, absolutely! 
Traditional martial arts forms seem like 
they'll be great reference☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After receiving guidance from Yaeno 
Muteki, Copano Rickey mastered a diverse 
set of moves.
